Export hangs when the archive holds more than 4096 entries #1842

alice-moreau opened 2 days ago Contributor

Exporting a project with a large archive never finishes. The progress bar reaches about eighty percent and then stays there until I close the window.

It looks related to the number of entries rather than their size: 4096 entries export fine, 4097 do not, whatever is in them.

$ tool export --project demo --out demo.zip
writing entry 4097 of 5210 ...

I can share the project privately if that helps, it is nothing confidential, just too big to attach here.

bob-okafor commented 2 days ago Member

Thanks, I can reproduce this on the current main branch with a generated archive.

carol-lindqvist commented yesterday Member

I think I know what this is. The writer keeps its central directory in a fixed buffer that was sized for the old format, and when the buffer is full it waits for a flush that the export path never asks for, because the export path was written before the buffer existed and nobody went back to it when the limit was introduced two releases ago.

I will open a pull request tonight. It should be a small change, the hard part was finding it.

dave-whitfield commented yesterday

Before that lands, a few things worth checking, because we have been bitten by this buffer before:

  • whether the import path has the same assumption, since it was written in the same week
  • whether the limit is documented anywhere a user would find it, which I doubt
  • whether the test archive in the repository is big enough to have caught this, which it clearly is not.
